summary: The tutorial explains how to use custom animations in LibreOffice Impress, specifically for Ubuntu users. To start, open a sample presentation in Impress and select the slides pane. Click on the thumbnail to view the slide. To add custom animations, select the text box on the left side of the slide and then click on the border. In the Impress window, go to the tasks pane and click on "Custom Animation." Choose "Add" to open the Custom Animation dialog box. Here, you can select the "Entrance" tab to control how objects are displayed on the screen. You can choose basic animations like diagonal squares and set their speed. Click "OK" to apply these settings. To preview the animation, click "Play" on the main screen. You can add more animations by selecting additional text boxes and choosing different animation types. To change the order of animations, double-click on an animation and adjust its properties in the Effects Options dialog box. For example, you can change the direction of the animation and set a delay. Finally, you can preview all selected animations together by clicking the play button.
